content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(TIM-002 IOC Match — Outbound Fetch From TAXII-Fed Staged-Capability Host) AND XQL(TIM-002 Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain Resolution Surfaced (NDR DNS leg)) -> join on src_host within 300s. Promotes a benign-looking lookup + fetch to a Resource-Development incident because the destination matches the adversary infrastructure published in the subscribed mocktaxii TAXII feed before any payload detonates.
rules.name: TIM — Adversary Resource-Development Infrastructure Reached On Estate
